senses.gloss:
अरोक a. [न˚ ब˚]
—1 Without holes (अच्छिद्र).
—2 Without splendour, obscured, dim.
.━{@Comp.@}: अरोकदत्, अरोकदन्त

अरोक + -दत्, -दन्त a. [विभाषाश्यावारोकाभ्याम् P. V. 4. 144]
—1 having black teeth.
—2 having thickset teeth (निबिडदन्त).

अरोक + -दत्, -दन्त a. [विभाषाश्यावारोकाभ्याम् P. V. 4. 144]
—1 having black teeth.
—2 having thickset teeth (निबिडदन्त).
अरोग a. Free from disease, healthy, sound, well; अरोगाः सर्वसिद्धार्थाश्चतुर्वर्षशतायुषः Suśr.
अरोग + .{@-गः@} Sound health; न नाममात्रेण करोत्यरोगम् H. 1. 146.

अरोगण a. Ved.
—1 Freeing from disease; तेषामसि त्वमुत्तममनास्रावमरोगणम् Av. 2. 3. 2.
—2 Free from disease.

अरोगत्वम् Healthiness; यमो दण्डादवध्यत्वमरोगत्वं च दत्तवान्
 Rām. 7. 36. 16.
अरोगिन्, अरोग्य a. Healthy.
अरोगिन्, अरोग्य a. Healthy.

अरोचक a. (-चिका f.)
—1 Not shining or bright.
—2 Causing loss of appetite, producing loathing or disgust.
अरोचक + .{@-कः@} Loss of appetite; disgust, loathing.
अरोचकिन् a. Suffering from loss of appetite or indigestion.

अरोचमान a.
—1 Not shining.
—2 Not attached; तस्यां त्वरोचमानायां सर्वमेव न रोचते Ms. 3. 62.

अरोचिष्णु a.
—1 Not shining, dark.
—2 Disagreeable, ugly.
अरोषः Absence of anger, calmness.

—1 Shining through.
—2 Small points of light between the threads of a web.
आरोचन a. Shining.

आरोधनम् Ved.
—1 Obstruction, means of obstruction.
—2 A secret place, innermost part.
आरोढृ a. One who climbs, ascends.

—1 Attributing the nature or properties of one thing to another; वस्तुन्यवस्त्वारोपोऽध्यारोपः
 Vedānta S.; attributing or assigning to, imputation; दोषारोपो गुणेष्वपि Ak.
—2 Considering as equal; identification (as in सारोपा लक्षणा).
—3 Super-imposition.
—4 Imposing (as a burden), burdening or charging with.
—5 Placing in or upon.
—6 Relating to.
—7 Superior position.
आरोपक a. Placing, fixing, planting गृहसंवेशको दूतो वृक्षारोपक एव च Ms.

—1 placing or fixing in or upon, putting; आर्द्राक्षतारोपणमन्वभूताम्
 R. 7. 28; Ku. 7. 88; (fig.) establishing, installing; अधिकारारोपणम् Mu. 3.
—2 Causing to mount or ascend, raising (to heaven).
—3 Planting.
—4 The stringing of a bow.
—5 Trusting, delivering.

आरोपयितृ a. One who places upon (his body), wears; न तानि
 कश्चिन्माल्यानि तत्रारोपयिता नरः 3. 73. 22.

आरोपित p. p.
—1 Raised, elevated.
—2 Fixed, placed, made; आरोपितपर्याणं च त्वरिततुरगपरिचारकोपनीतमिन्द्रायुधम्; K.
—3 Strung (as a bow).
—4 Deposited, entrusted.
—5 Consecrated, hallowed.
—6 Accidental, adventitious, ascribed.

आरोहः [आ-रुह्-घञ्]
—1 One who mounts, a rider, as in अश्वारोह, स्यन्दनारोह; सारोहाणां
 च वाजिनाम् Rām.; one who is seated in a carriage.
—2 Ascent, rising, mounting,
[]
 ascending, riding; आरोहे विनये चैव युक्तो वारणवाजिनाम् Rām. 2. 1. 28.
—3 An elevated place, elevation, altitude; height; नगाद्यारोह; उच्छ्रायः
 Ak.; Mb. 13. 147. 16.
—4 Haughtiness, pride.
—5 A mountain, a heap.
—6 A womanʼs waist; the buttocks; सा रामा न वरारोहा Udb.; आरोहैर्निबिडबृहन्नितम्बबिम्बैः
 Śi. 8. 8; Bhāg. 10. 6. 16.
—7 Length.
—8 A kind of measure.
—9 A mine.
—10 Descending.

आरोहक a.
—1 Ascending, mounting, riding.
—2 Raising up, elevating. —3 Rising.

—1 The act of rising, ascending, mounting; आरोहणार्थं नवयौवनेन
 कामस्य सोपानमिव प्रयुक्तम् Ku. 1. 39.
—2 Riding (on a horse &c.).
—3 A stair-case, ladder; अथारोहणमासाद्य वेदिकान्तरमाश्रितः Rām. 5. 10. 13.
—4 The rising or growing of new shoots, growing (of plants).
—5 A raised stage for dancing.
—6 A carriage (Ved.).
आरोहणिक a. Relating to mounting or ascending.
आरोहिन् a. Ascending, mounting.
आरोग्यम् + -अम्बु n. Healthful water.
आरोग्यम् + -चिन्तामणिः N. of a work.
आरोग्यम् + -प्रतिपद्व्रतम् A ceremony for gaining health.
आरोग्यम् + -शाला a hospital.
आरोग्यय् Den. P. To wish health.
